text:
katie: Hey all — quick schedule update for next week's RFC review on Wed 9am PT. We have three author slots but two authors asked to swap. Can folks claim reviewer slots or volunteer to swap times? RFC links below.

katie: RFCs:
- https://redwood.intern/docs/rfcs/2026-03-rpc-routing
- https://redwood.intern/docs/rfcs/2026-02-model-caching

katie: Current agenda (9:00 start):
```
9:00 — Intro + housekeeping (5m)
9:05 — RPC routing RFC — author @sam (20m)
9:25 — Model caching RFC — author @marta (20m)
9:45 — Open q/a + rollcall (15m)
```

katie: Action items:
- Authors: please post 1-sentence TL;DR in thread and link to pre-read section (if updated).
- Reviewers: sign up in this sheet: https://sheets.gsheet/rfc-review-roster
- If you need to swap, say which slot.

sam: I can move to the 9:25 slot if that helps. My team has a sprint demo at 9:00. @katie ok?

marta: 9:25 works for me. I'll take 9:05 instead. swapping ok @katie?

katie: @sam @marta awesome — confirmed. Updated agenda:
```
9:05 — Model caching — @marta
9:25 — RPC routing — @sam
```

jin: I'll be a reviewer for model caching. Added my name to the sheet.

leo: Can do RPC routing review. Leaving a note in the sheet. Also can take the first 5 min of q/a to cover perf numbers.

obinna: Sorry can't make Wed AM, but happy to pre-review RPC RFC and leave comments in doc. I'll tag points inline by EOD Tue.

deploy-bot: Reminder: please attach the pre-read PDF to the meeting invite by Tue 11:00 for attendee prep. :bell:

katie: Thanks everyone. Two final asks:
1) Authors — paste a one-liner TL;DR by Tue noon
2) Reviewers — please add 2 specific ask/questions in the sheet so we can prioritize discussion

sam: TL;DR posted in RFC doc (top). Quick note: planning to demo a perf chart during the review.

marta: TL;DR posted. Also added a short "what to look for" section at top of pre-read.

jin: added 2 questions in sheet.

leo: added perf metric we want validated. :thumbsup:

katie: Great. I'll update calendar agenda and send one last ping Tue AM. Thanks!
